build_ChannelPool_module: build a PyTorch module that performs average pooling across the channel dimension of a tensor
build_SEModule_for_attention: build a Squeeze-and-Excitation module that gates feature channels using sigmoid weights from spatial and channel attention
build_Modulation_for_conditional_feature: build a conditional modulation module that applies learned linear and convolutional transforms to modulate features
build_MovieBottleneck_with_modulation: build a ResNet bottleneck block with MoVie modulation and optional SE attention for multimodal feature processing
build_AvgPoolBottleneck_for_resnet: build a ResNet bottleneck block that uses average pooling instead of strided convolutions for spatial downsampling
